source_name: ARBK — Kosovo Business Registration Agency (Agjencia për Regjistrimin e Bizneseve të Kosovës)
organization: ARBK / Ministry of Industry, Entrepreneurship and Trade (MINT)
rate_limits: Services/* return HTTP 401 without bearer; KerkoBiznesin requires Cloudflare Turnstile token; no open bulk; EksportoBizneset gated
notes: Official Kosovo company register. SPA API base /api/api/. All Services/* return 401 (bearer required); search (KerkoBiznesin) is Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA-gated; export (EksportoBizneset) also gated. No open bulk/API. Usable via browser only — controls NOT bypassed. Field model documented from the SPA JS/i18n. NUI = Numri Fiskal = business id (9-digit); Numri TVSH = VAT (separate). Owners (Pronarët) = personal data, redact. Tri-lingual (sq/sr/en).

organization: Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës (ATK / Tax Administration of Kosovo)
rate_limits: per-company lookup; Cloudflare/Google CAPTCHA required ('I'm not a robot'); no open bulk
notes: Per-company tax/VAT verification by Emri / Nr. Fiskal / NRB / Nr. TVSh. Rich output (FiscalNo, NrbID, TpStatus, TpName, Address, City, VatNo, VatTypeAl) confirms the identifier model. CAPTCHA-gated ('Kliko I am not a robot') — not bypassed. No open bulk. Catalogued from the public form fields.

source_name: ATK — Open Data (Të dhënat e hapura)
notes: Real downloadable XLSX, but AGGREGATE statistics (employer/employee counts and declarations by sector, municipality, subject type, year) — NOT company-level (no fiscal number or business name). Useful for sector/employment context only. Verified columns.
National open-data portal did not resolve (opendata.rks-gov.net, data.rks-gov.net). No working portal hosting the company register openly at investigation time.
